notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:fetch-cited-2-2026-10-10. Proposed by fetch-cited-2-2026-10-10 for Comoros (AFP: "gratuity" of $105m to an ex-president, $29m to the promoter) and Austria (Der Standard: USD 2m and EUR 900,000 paid in connection with two special-interest naturalisations). Distinct from cbi_revenue_missing (money that should have reached the state) and investor_funds_misappropriated (money taken from investors).

name: Irregular investor residence grants detected
definition: Persons found by an authority to have obtained investor-linked residence irregularly, whether or not withdrawn.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-other. Proposed by extract-other for the Oman State Audit Institution finding (2024 Society Summary, p. 40). Residence counterpart of irregular_naturalisations_detected.

name: Long-term ("golden") residence permits issued, all categories
definition: Long-term ("golden") residence permits issued in a period across all eligibility categories (investors, talent, professionals, family...), not limited to investors.
notes: added by research:uae. Use residence_permits_issued (with breakdown route=...) for investor-only counts. UAE figures are mostly Dubai (breakdown emirate=dubai). Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Cantons applying lump-sum taxation
definition: Number of Swiss cantons that apply expenditure-based (lump-sum) taxation at a date, as stated by the source; the federal level is not counted.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:fetch-cited-6-2026-10-10. Proposed by fetch-cited-6; the data otherwise records abolitions only as events.

name: Share of lump-sum taxpayers or revenue in a group of regions
definition: Percentage of lump-sum taxpayers, or of lump-sum tax revenue, located in a stated canton or group of cantons, as printed.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-che1. proposed by extract-cbi-che1 for the 2011 Federal Council message (73.9% of lump-sum taxpayers and 77.8% of cantonal and communal revenue in VD, VS, TI and GE).

name: Tax paid per lump-sum taxpayer (lowest, highest or average)
definition: Lowest, highest or average tax collected from one person taxed on a lump-sum (expenditure) basis in a period (category=lowest/highest/average), as printed.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-che1. proposed by extract-cbi-che1 for the FDK surveys of Swiss cantons (lowest and highest lump-sum tax 2008-2018; average CHF 180,162 in 2018).

name: Tax revenue from lump-sum (expenditure-based) taxation
definition: Tax collected in a period from people taxed on a lump-sum or expenditure basis, all levels of government unless category= says.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:europe-rest.

name: Change in lump-sum tax revenue
definition: Printed change in tax collected from people taxed on a lump-sum basis between two periods, as printed; category= for the level of government. Never computed by us.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:fetch-cited-5-2026-10-10. Proposed by fetch-cited-5-2026-10-10 for che-blick-2026-08-23.

name: People taxed on a lump-sum (expenditure) basis
definition: People taxed on their living expenses instead of income and wealth, at a date (a stock).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:europe-rest. For tax-residence regimes for wealthy foreigners. Not a count of permits.

name: Change in the number of lump-sum taxpayers
definition: Printed change (increase positive, decrease negative) in the number of people taxed on a lump-sum (expenditure) basis between two dates, in a canton or nationally, as printed. Never computed by us from levels.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:fetch-cited-5-2026-10-10. Proposed by fetch-cited-5-2026-10-10 for che-blick-2026-08-23, which prints changes since 2012 for cantons whose 2012 level it does not print.

name: Main applicants approved
definition: Main applicants granted citizenship or residence in a period; first grants only.

name: Average minimum investment across programmes
definition: Average of the minimum investment amounts of several programmes (e.g. the most popular EU schemes), as calculated and printed by the source; the notes list the programmes and amounts used. Never calculated by us.
notes: proposed by research:extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11. Proposed by extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11 for Transparency International / Global Witness 'European Getaway' (2018): average EU entry ticket around EUR 900,000.

name: Projected minimum investment amount
definition: Government projection of a programme's minimum investment amount after future automatic adjustments under stated scenarios. Not a term in force.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 (EB-5 Modernization rule Table 4).

name: CBI development-fund assets as a share of GDP
definition: Accumulated assets of a CBI-financed development or savings fund as a percentage of GDP.
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: CBI development-fund surplus as a share of GDP
definition: Income minus spending of a CBI-financed development fund in a period, as a percentage of GDP.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-kna1. Proposed by extract-cbi-kna1 for IMF WP/15/93 Box 5 (SIDF surplus 2007-2013).

name: Subsidised credit backed by a CBI-financed development fund, percent of GDP
definition: Below-market credit backed by deposits of a CBI-financed development fund, as a stock (category=facilities_outstanding) or annual subsidy (category=annual_subsidy), as a percentage of GDP.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-intl3. Proposed by extract-cbi-intl3 for IMF WP/15/93 Box 5 (SIDF facilities 'about 1.5 percent of GDP by end-2013', subsidies 'about 0.05 percent of GDP per year'). No existing indicator covers NDF-backed lending.

name: Payment out of a CBI development fund (line item)
definition: One payment out of a citizenship-by-investment development fund (Antigua's National Development Fund), as listed line by line by the programme (one row per line). Period is the payment date (day precision); breakdown item=p<page>-l<line>. Where a list prints the same payment in two currencies (US$ and its EC$/XCD equivalent), each is a row with its own unit. Details and payee in notes. Money.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-atg-rest-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-atg-rest-2026-10-10 for the Antigua CIU six-monthly reports (2015 H2 Appendix VII, 2016 H2 Appendix IX). Line-item companion of cbi_fund_payments category=ndf (totals). Amounts in the lists' 'Transfers to Consolidated Fund in EC$' column are recorded as cbi_transfers_to_government category=consolidated_fund with the same item=.

name: CBI development-fund spending as a share of GDP
definition: Spending of a CBI-financed development fund in a period, as a percentage of GDP. Breakdown category= for components.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-kna1. Proposed by extract-cbi-kna1 for IMF WP/15/93 Box 5 (SIDF operations 2007-2013). Companion to ndf_income_pct_gdp.

name: CBI development-fund income as a share of GDP
definition: Income of a CBI-financed national development fund in a period as a percentage of GDP; category=cbi_contributions when only CBI contributions are counted.
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Separate from cbi_fiscal_revenue, which covers the central budget Merged with cbi_ndf_income_pct_gdp (research:st-kitts-nevis); may include investment income, see row notes. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Passports an inquiry found improperly issued
definition: Passports (ordinary, diplomatic or official) that an official inquiry, audit or court found were issued without legal basis or to people not entitled to them, e.g. diplomatic passports given to foreigners in sham consular posts in a passport-sale context. Count of passports, cumulative over the period the inquiry covers; breakdown category= for passport type or a condition the source uses. Not passports issued through a lawful programme (use passports_issued).
notes: proposed by research:extract-partials-p6-2026-10-11. Proposed by extract-partials-p6-2026-10-11 for the Vanuatu Ombudsman's 1998 report on diplomatic and official passports.

name: CBI passports issued
definition: Passports issued to people who got citizenship through the programme in a period (unit passports, or persons where the source counts people).
notes: added by research:antigua-barbuda. Close to persons_naturalised but counts passports; Antigua's CIU reports it by year, and the yearly series changes between report vintages. Reviewed 2026-09-28. Merged with cbi_passports_issued (research:context-timeline). Passports can exceed persons naturalised (renewals).

name: Valid permanent residence permits (stock)
definition: People holding a valid permanent residence permit on a date, for the categories the source covers (may include non-investors).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:africa-indian-ocean. Proposed by research:africa-indian-ocean for Mauritius (EDB annual report).

name: People granted citizenship
definition: Persons naturalised through the programme in a period (main applicants plus dependants unless noted).

name: Change in persons naturalised
definition: Percentage change in the number of persons granted citizenship under a programme between a period and an earlier one, as printed. Never calculated by us.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-mlt-rest-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-mlt-rest-2026-10-10 (Malta regulator 2017 report: +182%).

name: Persons naturalised without a stated document
definition: Persons naturalised through a programme who, according to the source, did not provide a stated document (category=, e.g. birth_certificate). Usually a claim; not a finding that the naturalisation was irregular.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-mlt-images-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-mlt-images-2026-10-10 (an MP's claim of 58 IIP citizens without their own birth certificate, relayed in the 2019-2020 regulator report).

name: Approved investor petitions awaiting a visa number
definition: Approved investor petitions whose principals have not yet obtained residence because no visa number is available, at a date. Petitions, not people.
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. added by research:usa-eb5. Stock at a date; measures the visa backlog, not demand. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Potential demand for investor programmes
definition: Estimated number of people worldwide (or in a region) who could plausibly use citizenship- or residence-by-investment programmes, as estimated by the source (status estimate).
notes: proposed by research:extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11. Proposed by extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11 for the EPRS EAVA (2021) Annex II: about 4.3 million for RBI and under 400,000 for CBI.

name: Primary balance excluding CBI revenue (amount)
definition: Central government primary balance excluding programme revenue, in currency, as calculated by the source.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-dma1. Proposed by extract-cbi-dma1 for IMF Dominica Article IV statements of operations in EC$ ("Primary balance (excl. CBI)"). The amount counterpart of primary_balance_excl_cbi_pct_gdp.

name: Primary balance excluding CBI revenue, percent of GDP
definition: Central government primary balance excluding programme revenue, as a percentage of GDP.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-grd1. Proposed by extract-cbi-grd1 for IMF Grenada 2016 Article IV Table 1 ('Primary balance (excl. CBI revenues)'). The primary-balance counterpart of fiscal_balance_excl_cbi_pct_gdp.

name: Procedure attentions (gob.ec 'Atenciones')
definition: Number of times a government procedure was attended or served in a period, as counted by Ecuador's official procedures portal ('Atenciones'); the portal does not say whether this counts applications handled or visas granted.
notes: proposed by research:research-cbi-new-countries-clean-2026-10-10. Proposed for Ecuador's investor visa transparency table; kept separate from applications_processed because the meaning is not defined.

name: Government cost per application processed
definition: Average cost to the government of processing one programme application to a final decision in a period (total processing costs divided by applications processed), as printed by the source. Never calculated by us.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-fullcopies-2026-10-10. proposed by extract-cbi-fullcopies-2026-10-10 for the CIC 2014 BIP evaluation, Table 6.2 (Investor class $1,984 per application; text $1,958).

name: Processing time
definition: Time within which a programme authority decides or screens a type of application, at a date, in the unit printed (days, weeks or months; value_high for a range or extendable maximum). Breakdown form= or stage for what is timed, category= or measure= for mean, median, percentile, maximum or goal; status budget for targets. Never converted.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11); replaces processing_time_months and the indicators merged into it.

name: Share of applications by processing-time band
definition: Percentage of applications (approved unless noted) decided within a band of time from filing. Breakdown category= for the band.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-cyp1. proposed by extract-cbi-cyp1 (Cyprus Audit Office special report 2022, p. 30 pie chart).

name: Programme activity (measure not defined by the source)
definition: Yearly count a source reports as a programme's 'activity' or volume without saying whether it counts applications, approvals, visas or people; kept separate so it is never mixed with defined counts. Unit unspecified.
notes: proposed by research:extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11. Proposed by extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11 for the Irish IIP interim evaluation (2018), Table 2.2 (UK Tier 1, US EB-5, Portugal golden visa, Quebec IIP, 2012-2016).

name: Programme participants who left
definition: People or households in an investment-migration or wealthy-resident regime who left the country or region in a period, as printed.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-che1. proposed by extract-cbi-che1 for the 2011 Federal Council message (92 of 201 lump-sum-taxed households left Zurich by end-2010 after cantonal abolition).

name: Programme filings approved (other forms)
definition: Filings under a programme's forms other than the main investor petition and the petition to remove conditions (e.g. EB-5 regional-center designation I-924/I-956, project I-956F, annual statements I-924A/I-956G, bona fides I-956H, promoter I-956K) approved in a period. Breakdown form=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa4. proposed by extract-cbi-usa4; companion of programme_filings_received.

name: Programme filings denied (other forms)
definition: Filings under the other programme forms (as for programme_filings_approved) denied in a period. Breakdown form=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa4. proposed by extract-cbi-usa4.

name: Programme filings pending (other forms)
definition: Filings under the other programme forms awaiting a decision at a date (a stock). Breakdown form=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa4. proposed by extract-cbi-usa4 (USCIS all-forms "Pending").

name: Programme filings decided (other forms)
definition: Filings under the other programme forms decided in a period. Breakdown form=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa4. proposed by extract-cbi-usa4 (USCIS all-forms "Total Completions").

name: Programme filings received (all or other forms)
definition: Filings under the other programme forms received (or forecast) in a period; empty breakdown = the source's all-form total. Breakdown form=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 for the EB-5 fee rules (Forms I-527, I-956F, I-956G, I-956H, I-956K and all-form totals). Investor petitions stay in applications_received, I-829 in conditions_removal_petitions_received, I-956 in regional_center_applications_received.

name: Programme investment funds meeting a stated condition
definition: Number of approved programme investment funds that meet a condition the source states (measure=received_capital: funds that have received programme capital; measure=invested_in_sector: funds with programme-funded investment in the sector given by sector=), at a date. Not the number of funds approved (eligible_investment_funds).
notes: proposed by research:updates-2026-10-2026-10-11. Proposed by updates-2026-10 (MBIE AIP quarterly report Q4 FY2025/26, Annex Two Tables One and Three).

name: Programme marketing spending
definition: Money a programme authority, concessionaire or agent says it spent on promoting a programme in a period. Money; who spent it goes in notes or category=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:fetch-cited-3-2026-10-10. Proposed by fetch-cited-3 (Malta MRVP concessionaire claim, 2018).

name: Average characteristic of programme migrants
definition: Average of a characteristic of programme migrants or their businesses other than income (years of experience, businesses owned, ownership share, tax paid), as printed; category= says what, unit gives its unit.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-can1. proposed by extract-cbi-can1 for the CIC 2014 evaluation of the federal Business Immigration Program (survey and IMDB averages for Investor class immigrants).

name: Income of programme migrants
definition: Typical annual income (average, median or approximate, as stated) of programme migrants in a period. Breakdown applicant= and category=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-aus2. proposed by extract-cbi-aus2 for the 2023 Review of the Migration System, Figure 49 (approximate incomes of Investor visa primary applicants by age, ABS Census 2016).

name: Programme migrants counted in a study
definition: Number of programme immigrants (or applicants) counted in a study population, such as tax records or survey respondents; usually the 'out of' number behind printed percentages. category= names the group. Printed by the source, never calculated by us.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11), approved by Oscar.

name: Programme participants (unspecified stock or cumulative)
definition: Persons a source counts as participants in (or as having taken up) a residence or citizenship programme, where the source does not say whether it means people holding the status at a date or everyone admitted since the programme began. Count of persons; breakdown nationality= (or country=) as printed. Use residence_permits_valid or residence_permits_issued instead when the source settles which.
notes: proposed by research:extract-partials-p1-2026-10-11. Proposed by extract-partials-p1-2026-10-11 for the Sarawak minister's top-10 'participants' figures (Oct 2024).

name: Programme share of a combined budget or cost
definition: Percentage of the costs of a wider government programme or budget line attributable to the investor programme, as printed.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-can1. proposed by extract-cbi-can1 for the CIC 2014 BIP evaluation (Investor class 56.6% of BIP costs 2006/07-2011/12).

name: Programme grants as a share of all grants of the same status
definition: Percentage of all first residence permits (category=first_residence_permits) or all naturalisations (category=naturalisations) in a country in a period granted through the investor programme, as printed.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-intl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-intl2 for EPRS PE 627.128 (2018), Table 1 (RBI permits as % of all first-time residence permits) and p. 18 (share of naturalisations through the CBI scheme).

name: Programme figure as a share of a national total
definition: A programme figure expressed by the source as a percentage of a national total of the same kind other than residence permits or naturalisations (which use programme_share_of_grants): e.g. enterprises supported as a share of all active enterprises, programme investment as a share of national FDI. category= names both. Never calculated by us.
notes: proposed by research:extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11. Proposed by extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11 for the Irish IIP interim evaluation (enterprise option supported about 0.02% of active enterprises, 2012-2016).

name: Programme holders switching to another immigration route
definition: People holding programme permission who were granted permission in another immigration category in a period. category=to_<new category>.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-gbr1. proposed by extract-cbi-gbr1 for UK Home Office Exe_D02 (extensions by previous category of leave, 2015-2020).

name: Monitoring reports on programme projects adopted
definition: Independent monitoring reports on programme projects adopted by the government or authority, cumulative to a date or in a period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-mne1. Proposed by extract-cbi-mne1 (Montenegro: Government adoption of independent controllers' reports on tourism development projects). The number of projects covered goes in cbi_projects_monitored.

name: Project proposals declined
definition: Investment project proposals declined as qualifying investments in a period. Breakdown route=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-nzl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-nzl2 (NZTE acceptable-investment decisions for Active Investor Plus).

name: Project proposals awaiting a decision
definition: Investment project proposals awaiting a decision at a date (a stock).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-irl2. proposed by extract-cbi-irl2 for the Irish IIP wind-down, where about 90 project proposals were still undecided in July and December 2025 alongside 1,400-1,600 investor applications (applications_pending counts main applicants, so it does not fit).

name: Project proposals received
definition: Investment project proposals (businesses or funds seeking to become qualifying investments) submitted in a period. Breakdown route=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-nzl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-nzl2 for NZTE's assessments of businesses and managed funds applying to be acceptable Active Investor Plus investments (MBIE briefing, Oct 2024). Companions: cbi_projects_approved, project_proposals_declined, project_proposals_withdrawn, project_proposals_pending (proposed by extract-cbi-irl2).

name: Project proposals withdrawn
definition: Investment project proposals withdrawn before a decision in a period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-nzl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-nzl2 (NZTE acceptable-investment decisions for Active Investor Plus).

name: Properties acquired for citizenship
definition: Real-estate units bought or leased under a programme's real-estate route, in a period.
notes: added by research:turkey. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Consents for property purchases granted to programme participants
definition: Consents or permissions granted by a regulator (e.g. the New Zealand Overseas Investment Office) allowing programme visa holders to buy or build residential property outside the programme route, at a date or in a period. Consents, not completed purchases.
notes: proposed by research:updates-2026-10-2026-10-11. Proposed by updates-2026-10 (MBIE AIP quarterly report Q4 FY2025/26, para 19 and Table Four). Not property_purchases_by_programme_participants, which counts completed purchases.

name: Property purchases by programme participants (outside the programme)
definition: Property purchases by people who got status through a programme, made outside the programme's real-estate route, in a period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-sgp2. Proposed by extract-cbi-sgp2 for Singapore written answer of 9 May 2022 (21 landed purchases 2004-2021 by citizens who first got PR through the GIP). Not properties_acquired_for_cbi, which counts purchases under a programme's real-estate route.

name: Time taken for an application cap to fill
definition: Time between the opening of an application intake and the moment its cap (quota) was reached, in the unit printed (minutes, hours, days); value_high for 'within N'. Never converted.
notes: proposed by research:extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11. Proposed by extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11 for UK MAC (2014) para 4.29: Canada's 700-application federal IIP quota met within 30 minutes of release in 2011.

name: Members paying a residence scheme's annual fee
definition: Members (principal accounts) of a residence or retirement-visa scheme who paid the scheme's annual membership fee in a period, as printed. Not all persons covered (dependants are included in a principal's fee).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-images-other-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-images-other-2026-10-10 (Philippine Retirement Authority 2016: 8,326 members paid the Annual PRA Fee).

name: Extra financing cost of investor-programme bonds
definition: Estimated extra cost to the state of borrowing through investor-programme bonds compared with ordinary borrowing.
notes: added by research:hungary-latvia. added by research:hungary-latvia. Always an estimate; method in notes. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Investor-programme bonds as a share of state financing
definition: Proceeds or face value of investor-programme government bonds as a percentage of a stated government financing aggregate (gross financing need, total or foreign-currency debt, foreign-currency funding raised), as printed by the source. Breakdown category= names the aggregate.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:fetch-cited-1-2026-10-10. Proposed by fetch-cited-1-2026-10-10 for the TI Hungary/KFIB study (Table 4 and section 4); no existing share indicator covers bond financing.

name: Investor-programme bonds outstanding
definition: Face value of investor-programme government bonds not yet repaid, at a date.
notes: added by research:hungary-latvia. added by research:hungary-latvia. Stock at a date; face value, not cash raised (discount bonds). Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Investor-programme bonds repaid
definition: Face value of investor-programme bonds repaid at maturity in a period.
notes: added by research:hungary-latvia. added by research:hungary-latvia. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Investor-programme bonds sold (count)
definition: Number of investor-programme bonds, bond packages or subscribing investors in a period; unit says which.
notes: added by research:hungary-latvia. added by research:hungary-latvia. Units differ: bond pieces vs one package per investor; check unit and notes. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Businesses receiving programme investment
definition: Businesses receiving investor capital under a programme (e.g. EB-5 new commercial enterprises), at a date or in a period. Breakdown category=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 for DHS EB-5 integrity NPRM (2026).

name: Programme capital deployed by investment vehicles
definition: Money that programme investors committed to an investment vehicle (e.g. a managed fund) which the vehicle has called and invested in underlying businesses or assets, at a date, as reported by the authority. Excludes capital committed but uncalled or held as cash.
notes: proposed by research:updates-2026-10-2026-10-11. Proposed by updates-2026-10 for the Invest NZ recertification check in the MBIE AIP quarterly report Q4 FY2025/26 (Annex Two Table One).

name: Share of committed programme capital deployed
definition: Percentage of programme capital committed to investment vehicles that has been deployed, at a date, as printed by the source. Never calculated by us.
notes: proposed by research:updates-2026-10-2026-10-11. Proposed by updates-2026-10 (MBIE AIP quarterly report Q4 FY2025/26).

name: Programme capital per project (distribution)
definition: Investor-programme capital per project as a distribution statistic (median, mean, maximum) over the source's sample. Not a total.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 (DHS small-entity analysis, 1,402 EB-5 projects FY 2018-2022).

name: Programme capital committed but not deployed
definition: Money committed by programme investors to an investment vehicle that has not yet been called or is held as cash by the vehicle, at a date, as reported by the authority.
notes: proposed by research:updates-2026-10-2026-10-11. Proposed by updates-2026-10 (MBIE AIP quarterly report Q4 FY2025/26, Annex Two Table One, column "Not deployed (uncalled or cash held)").

name: Programme deposits held (stock)
definition: Refundable deposits of programme members held by the agency or its depository banks, at a date (a stock).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-other. Proposed by extract-other (PRA restricted visa deposits / trust liabilities).

name: Net programme deposits
definition: Refundable programme deposits brought in by new members minus deposits returned to leaving members, in a period, as printed.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-other. Proposed by extract-other. The PRA calls it net foreign currency generated from visa deposits. Note: an existing row from phl-pra-ar-2017 records a net figure under rbi_investment_total.

name: Programme deposits returned on exit
definition: Refundable programme deposits paid back to members who left or died, in a period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-other. Proposed by extract-other (Philippine Retirement Authority visa-deposit tables). Companion to rbi_investment_total (gross deposits brought in).

name: Change in a programme's estimated economic benefit (percent, as printed)
definition: Printed percentage change in the modelled economic benefit of a programme (category= for the component, e.g. GVA) from the previous period. Never computed from levels.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-images-other-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-images-other-2026-10-10 (EY review of the Irish IIP, change labels on the GVA-by-year chart).

name: Estimated economic benefit of a programme
definition: Economic benefit of a programme to the host economy as modelled by an evaluation, in a period. Always estimate; category= for component and gross/net.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-irl1. proposed by extract-cbi-irl1 for the Irish Department of Justice interim evaluation of the IIP (2017), Table 6.6 (gross €74.8m and €11.4m; net ranges).

name: Share of a programme's estimated economic benefit by sector
definition: Percentage of the economic benefit of a programme (as modelled by an evaluation, e.g. gross value added) attributed to one sector or group (sector=, category= for the component), as printed. Never calculated by us.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-images-other-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-images-other-2026-10-10 (EY review of the Irish IIP, GVA pie chart).

name: Existing investments of people identified as eligible
definition: Official estimate of investments already held by people identified as eligible for a residence scheme; not new investment.
notes: added by research:uae. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: People identified as eligible for an investor residence scheme
definition: People the authorities say qualify for, or are targeted by, an investor or long-term residence scheme, at a date; not permits issued.
notes: added by research:uae. A target or eligibility pool, often announced at launch. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Revenue of programme businesses (distribution)
definition: Revenue of businesses involved in a programme as a distribution statistic over a sample. Not a total. category= for entity, sample and statistic.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 (DHS small-entity analysis, commercial database matches). Differs from rbi_intermediary_income (programme-wide profit or income).

name: Modelled lifetime fiscal impact per programme migrant
definition: Modelled average lifetime net fiscal impact of one programme migrant. Per person; always estimate.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-aus2. proposed by extract-cbi-aus2 for the 2023 Review of the Migration System, Figure 24 (Treasury FIONA model: BIIP -$80k per person).

name: Follow-on investment by programme investors
definition: Investment by programme migrants in addition to the investment their visa requires, in a period, as estimated or reported.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-nzl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-nzl2 for the BERL (2017) estimate of NZ$1.7 billion follow-on investment by Investor 1 and 2 migrants 2009-2017, cited in MBIE Cabinet papers and briefings. Distinct from rbi_investment_total (required qualifying investment).

name: Investor-programme funds allocated to regional funds
definition: Money raised by a government-run investor programme allocated to regional funds in a period (destination=), and amounts placed in a stated use (category=).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-can1. proposed by extract-cbi-can1 for Table 5.8 of the CIC 2014 evaluation (federal IIP allocations by province 2007-2011).

name: Implied annual cost of investor capital
definition: Annual rate at which a government or fund receiving investor capital effectively pays for it, as estimated by the source.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-can1. proposed by extract-cbi-can1 for the CIC 2014 evaluation (federal IIP commissions equivalent to about 1.5% / 1.1% a year).

name: Intermediary fees charged per investor
definition: Fees private intermediaries charge each investor on top of the qualifying investment, as reported by an authority; amount or percent of the investment, often a range.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa1. Proposed by extract-cbi-usa1 (DHS OIG-14-19: regional center fees of $25,000-$50,000 per investor). Not set by government, so not a programme term.

name: Fees collected from programme investors by an intermediary (total)
definition: Total fees a private intermediary collected from programme investors on top of the qualifying investment, in a case or period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa4. proposed by extract-cbi-usa4 (SEC 2013-20: USD 11 million of administrative fees in the Chicago Convention Center case).

name: Income of programme intermediaries
definition: Profit or income retained by private intermediaries or agents from a programme, as estimated or reported.
notes: added by research:hungary-latvia. added by research:hungary-latvia. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Average investment per investor (or per property)
definition: Average qualifying investment per investor, or average value of the asset bought (e.g. per property), in a period, as printed. Notes say what is averaged.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-hkg3. Proposed by extract-cbi-hkg3 for Hong Kong LegCo replies: HK$7.17 million per CIES entrant (LCQ15, 9 June 2004) and an average residential property value of around $10 million (LCQ12, 5 May 2010).

name: Investment intended (pipeline)
definition: Investment applicants have nominated or committed but not yet transferred (applications in progress or approved in principle), at a date.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:oceania. Distinct from rbi_investment_total (money invested or committed by approved investors).

name: Minimum investment of applications received
definition: Sum of the minimum investment amounts of applications received in a period (each at its category minimum), as printed. Not money invested.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-nzl1. Proposed by extract-cbi-nzl1 for the INZ Active Investor Plus statistics page (2025-2026 versions). Status projection: it is what the applications would bring if all went ahead. Distinct from rbi_investment_intended (pipeline) and rbi_investment_total (committed).

name: Investment pipeline plus committed capital
definition: One printed figure for pipeline investment plus capital committed by approved investors, cumulative from a start date.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-nzl1. Proposed by extract-cbi-nzl1 for INZ/ministerial headline totals (e.g. "around NZD $5.15 billion have been added to the investment pipeline or committed"). Sources usually also print the parts, recorded as rbi_investment_intended and rbi_investment_total; this keeps the headline without adding them up.

name: Share of programme investment by asset class or route
definition: Percentage of the total qualifying investment under a programme in a period that went into one asset class or route (route=), came from one nationality (nationality=), or went into one region (region=), as printed. Never calculated by us.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-hkg2. Proposed by extract-cbi-hkg2 for the InvestHK New CIES distribution tables (25 May 2025 and 2 March 2026), which print amounts and percentages side by side.

name: Programme money as share of project cost
definition: Percentage of the total cost of projects funded through a programme that comes from programme investors, as estimated by the source.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 (GAO-16-749R via DHS: median 29%, mean 40%; DHS 2016 NCE sample: 40% RC, 50% standalone).

name: Investment by programme investors
definition: Total qualifying investment made, or committed under approved applications, by programme investors in a period, as the source defines it.
notes: Added 2026-10-02 for residence programmes. Say in notes whether it is reported investment or applications multiplied by the minimum.

name: Qualifying investments made (count)
definition: Number of qualifying investments made by programme investors in a period, as counted by the authority.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 (USCIS counts of regional-center investments FY 2016-2021 and FY 2016-2025).

name: Jobs created by programme investors
definition: Jobs reported as created by businesses of programme investors, cumulative over the stated period, as defined by the source.
notes: added by research:singapore. Usually self-reported by investors and checked by the agency; say in notes whether limited to citizens. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Share of programme-linked jobs in a group of sectors
definition: Percentage of the jobs created or modelled for a programme that fall in a stated sector or group of sectors (sector=), as printed. Counts are rbi_jobs_created.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-images-other-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-images-other-2026-10-10 (EY review of the Irish IIP: construction and health 69% of modelled FTE jobs).

name: Jobs linked to programme migrants (estimate)
definition: Full-time-equivalent jobs estimated by an official body to depend on spending by people in an investment-migration or wealthy-resident regime. Always estimate.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-che1. proposed by extract-cbi-che1 for the ESTV estimate cited in the 2011 Federal Council message on Swiss lump-sum taxation (up to 22,497 jobs). Differs from rbi_jobs_created (jobs created by investors' businesses).

name: Benefit uses by programme members
definition: Number of times members of a residence programme sold as a membership (e.g. Thailand Privilege/Elite) used or booked a programme benefit (airport assistance, lounges, transfers, spa, government liaison) in a period, in total or by benefit (category=); unit uses for counts, percent for a benefit's printed share of all uses.
notes: proposed by research:extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11. Proposed by extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11 for the Thailand Privilege Card annual report FY2568 (214,876 uses; top-5 benefits).

name: Members of a residence-linked membership scheme (stock)
definition: Persons holding a valid membership on a date in a scheme that grants a long-stay visa as part of the membership (e.g. Thailand Privilege).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:asia.

name: Residence-linked memberships sold
definition: Paid memberships sold in a period under a visa-linked membership scheme, counted by card.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:asia. Not the same as visas issued: a family package may cover several people, and visas are issued separately by immigration.

name: Share of programme projects with a feature
definition: Percentage of programme investment projects with a stated feature (e.g. blending non-programme capital), as printed. A share of projects, not of money (rbi_investment_share).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

name: Share of programme businesses that are small
definition: Percentage of programme intermediaries or businesses (regional centers, new commercial enterprises, job-creating entities) found to be small entities under a size standard in an impact analysis, as printed; breakdown category=/sample= for group and sample.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

name: Total business expenditure by programme investors
definition: Total business expenditure (operating plus capital) by companies of programme investors over the stated period, as reported. Not the qualifying investment.
notes: added by research:singapore. Singapore GIP reports this for the direct-investment route. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Requests for review of a refusal
definition: Complaints or requests for review of a refused programme application lodged with the authority or regulator that reviews refusals, in a period or cumulatively; empty breakdown = received; category=investigated, accepted or refused for what the reviewer did with them, as printed.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-mlt-images-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-mlt-images-2026-10-10 (Malta regulator: IIP requests for review and 2020-scheme complaints, 2019-2020 to 2024 reports).

name: Investment-pooling entities approved (stock)
definition: Intermediary entities authorised to pool investor money at a date (e.g. EB-5 regional centers).
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. added by research:usa-eb5. Stock at a date. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Investment-pooling entities that paid the annual programme fee
definition: Intermediary entities that paid the programme's annual fee for a fiscal year.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3. A lower-bound proxy for active designated entities.

name: Investment-pooling entities terminated
definition: Intermediary entities whose designation was terminated in a period or cumulatively to a date.
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. added by research:usa-eb5. Say the cut-off and scope in notes. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Share of applications or agents reviewed by the oversight body
definition: Percentage of a programme's applications (approved, rejected or withdrawn, as category= says) or agents that the regulator or oversight body vetted, sampled, re-reviewed or interviewed in a period, as printed. category= names the group and the kind of review (e.g. approved_applications_vetted, approved_unvetted, agents_interviewed).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-mlt-rest-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-mlt-rest-2026-10-10 (Malta regulator vetting coverage, 2015-2019 reports).

name: Credit to a CBI-financed escrow fund (line item)
definition: One credit (deposit) to an escrow fund financed by a citizenship-by-investment programme (Antigua's Renewable Energy Escrow Fund), as listed line by line. Period is the credit date; breakdown item=p<page>-l<line>. Money.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-atg-rest-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-atg-rest-2026-10-10 for the Antigua CIU 2016 H2 report, Appendix VIII. Line-item companion of cbi_fund_credits category=renewable_energy_escrow.

name: Payment out of a CBI-financed escrow fund (line item)
definition: One payment out of an escrow fund financed by a citizenship-by-investment programme (Antigua's Renewable Energy Escrow Fund, paying PV Energy), as listed line by line (one row per line). Period is the payment date; breakdown item=p<page>-l<line>. Money.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-atg-rest-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-atg-rest-2026-10-10 for the Antigua CIU 2016 H2 report, Appendix VIII. Line-item companion of cbi_fund_payments category=renewable_energy_escrow. Could be merged with ndf_disbursement under a general fund line-item indicator with category=.

name: Investor residence permits cancelled or terminated (all reasons)
definition: Programme residence visas or memberships ended in a period for any reason (mostly at the holder's request), including those cancelled by authorities.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:asia. Used for the Philippine SRRV 'cancellations' series.

name: Investor residence permits issued
definition: Investor residence permits issued in a period (family members if noted).
notes: For residency programs

name: Change in investor residence permits issued (percent, as printed)
definition: Percentage change in investor residence permits issued between a period and an earlier one, as printed. Never computed from levels. Companion to residence_permits_issued.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-restated-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-restated-2026-10-10 (Greek legal-migration bulletins 2022-2026, p. 1 infographic arrow on permits issued to main investors).

name: Net enrolment in an investor residence programme
definition: New programme residents admitted in a period minus permits/memberships cancelled in the same period, as printed. Net flow.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-other. Proposed by extract-other for the Philippine SRRV, whose reports print gross enrolment, cancellations and net enrolment by year.

name: Residence permits in one period as a percentage of another (as stated)
definition: Investor residence permits of one period as a percentage of another period, as printed when counts are not. Never calculated by us.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-bra1. proposed by extract-cbi-bra1 for the OBMigra 2022 annual report (real-estate authorisations Jan-Jun 2022 about 78% of 2021; the yearly chart has no labels). Companion to investment_certificates_period_ratio_pct.

name: Investor residence permits renewed
definition: Investor residence permits renewed in a period.
notes: Added 2026-10-02 for residence programmes.

name: Investor residence permits revoked
definition: Investor-linked residence permits withdrawn by the authorities.
notes: added by research:hungary-latvia. added by research:hungary-latvia. Reviewed 2026-10-02. Merged with residence_status_revoked (research:singapore).

name: Valid investor-linked residence permits, all holders (stock)
definition: Investor-linked residence permits valid on a date (a stock); all holders and permit types unless the breakdown says applicant=main or applicant=family and permit_type=initial or renewal. One permit per person, so close to persons holding the status.
notes: added by research:greece. Stock at a date. One permit per person, so approximates persons holding the status. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Investor residence renewals refused
definition: Programme residents whose residence or re-entry permit was not renewed because conditions were not met, in a period.
notes: added by research:singapore. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Investor residence status retained
definition: Share of people granted residence through a programme in a period who still held it at a later date.
notes: added by research:singapore. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Government revenue excluding CBI, percent of GDP
definition: Total government revenue (tax and non-tax, with or without grants as the source says) excluding citizenship- or residence-by-investment revenue, as a percentage of GDP, as printed. Never calculated by us.
notes: proposed by research:extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11. Proposed by extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11 for IMF Antigua and Barbuda 2025 Article IV, Annex V para 6 (non-CBI total revenue 15.9% of GDP in 2023; ECCU average ex. ATG 24.6%). Companion to fiscal_balance_excl_cbi_pct_gdp.

name: Share of reviewed applications with a finding
definition: Percentage of the applications in a regulator's or auditor's review that showed a stated finding (category=: e.g. a missing document, a late payment, a late extension notice, due diligence with no issues), as printed. Counts of such cases are cases_meeting_condition.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-mlt-rest-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-mlt-rest-2026-10-10 (Malta regulator vetting observations, 2018-2022 reports).

name: Deprivations of programme citizenship decided
definition: Persons for whom the government decided to deprive programme citizenship in a period, whether or not completed.
notes: added by research:cyprus. Kept apart from citizenships_revoked (completed revocations). Cyprus reports both. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Deprivations of programme citizenship recommended
definition: Persons an inquiry, audit or committee recommends for deprivation (or examination of deprivation) of programme citizenship, at a date.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-cyp1. proposed by extract-cbi-cyp1 (Nicolatos inquiry report 2021, ch. 20).

name: Estimated impact of a rule change on programme users
definition: Monetised impact of a regulatory change on a programme's users as estimated in an impact analysis (costs, fee transfers, compliance costs), cumulative or per year. Status projection. Breakdown category=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 (regulatory impact analyses of the EB-5 fee rules).

name: Assessment score of a scheme (comparative study)
definition: Score a comparative study assigns to a programme on a stated scale (e.g. the 2018 EPRS scores for access conditions and rights granted, 0-9), as printed; category= names the dimension. Not a count or a money figure.
notes: proposed by research:extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11. Proposed by extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11 for EY's IIP review (2020): Ireland 5 and 5, UK 4 and 5, European average 5 on the EPRS 2018 scales.

name: Security-service recommendations to refuse
definition: Applicants for whom a state security service recommended refusal, in a period. Not refusals decided.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-lva2. proposed by extract-cbi-lva2 for the Latvian Security Police (38 foreigners in 2015).

name: Persons screened by the security service
definition: People checked by a state security or intelligence service as part of programme vetting, in a period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-lva2. proposed by extract-cbi-lva2 for the Latvian Security Police checks of prospective investor-permit recipients (2012-2014).

name: Programme service providers counted for a stated group
definition: Service providers (law firms, accountants, agents, developers) a source counts as active in a programme or for a stated group of applications.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-cyp1. proposed by extract-cbi-cyp1 (Nicolatos inquiry report 2021, chs. 5, 10, 20).

name: Permanent residence (settlement) grants to programme participants
definition: Grants of permanent residence (settlement) to people holding residence through an investor programme, in a period.
notes: added by research:closed-west. added by research:closed-west. Distinct from residence_permits_issued (first grants) and residence_permits_renewed (extensions). Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Single family offices with tax incentives
definition: Single family offices holding a government tax incentive at a date. Context.
notes: added by research:singapore. Context for family-office residence routes; the incentive itself gives no residence right. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Share of a multi-country total
definition: Percentage of a total that spans several countries or programmes (e.g. all approvals in key RBI programmes worldwide, all CBI approvals globally, all investment taken in by EU investment migration programmes) accounted for by one country, programme or group, as printed; category= names the group and the total. Never calculated by us.
notes: proposed by research:extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11. Proposed by extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11 for the EPRS European added value assessment (2021): EU share of global RBI approvals (52% 2015, 36% 2018, 25% 2019) and CBI approvals (9%, 6%), Turkey nearly half of global CBI approvals, PT/ES/EL/LV around 75% of EU RBI, Cyprus about 33% of EU investment intake in 2019.

name: Time per site visit
definition: Staff time per site visit or inspection of a programme entity (officer hours) or elapsed time from the visit to a determination (days), as a statistic printed by the source (category= mean, median, range). Not processing time of applications.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

name: Compliance site visits to programme entities
definition: Site visits, inspections or virtual checks of programme intermediaries or projects conducted by the authority in a period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 for DHS EB-5 integrity NPRM (2026) Table 13 and text. Say in notes whether virtual checks are included.

name: Special-interest applications put before the cabinet
definition: Applications for special-interest naturalisation put before the cabinet in a period.
notes: added by research:cambodia-macedonia-austria. Austria: 'Anträge gemäß § 10 Abs. 6 StbG im Ministerrat'. Distinct from applications filed with the Land authority (applications_received). Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Government confirmations of special interest
definition: Government confirmations that naturalising an applicant is in the state's special interest, in a period.
notes: added by research:cambodia-macedonia-austria. Austria: 'Bestätigungen gemäß § 10 Abs. 6 StbG durch die Bundesregierung'. Usually differs from persons_naturalised for the same year because of timing and family extensions. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Structural fiscal balance excluding CBI proceeds
definition: Structural fiscal balance excluding programme proceeds, as a percentage of potential GDP.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-mlt1. Proposed by extract-cbi-mlt1 for IMF Malta 2019 Article IV, Table 2 ("Structural balance excl. IIP proceeds"). Companion to fiscal_balance_excl_cbi_pct_gdp.

name: Structural primary balance excluding CBI proceeds
definition: Structural primary balance excluding programme proceeds, as a percentage of potential GDP.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-mlt1. Proposed by extract-cbi-mlt1 for IMF Malta 2019 Article IV, Table 2 ("Structural primary balance excl. IIP proceeds").

name: Sugar cane production
definition: Tonnes of sugar cane harvested in a year. Context.
notes: added by research:context-timeline. FAOSTAT QCL item "Sugar cane", element Production Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Sugar export value
definition: Value of sugar exports in a year, as defined by the source. Context.
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Sources differ in coverage and currency Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Sugar exports as a share of GDP
definition: Sugar exports as a percentage of GDP. Context.
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Sugar exports (quantity)
definition: Tonnes of raw sugar exported in a year. Context.
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Sugar company debt as a share of GDP
definition: Debt of the state sugar company as a percentage of GDP. Context.
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Sugar industry employment
definition: Persons employed by the sugar industry. Context.
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Sugar employment as a share of the labour force
definition: Sugar employment as a percentage of the labour force. Context.
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Denominators rarely stated Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Sugar industry losses as a share of GDP
definition: Annual operating losses of the state sugar industry as a percentage of GDP. Context.
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Raw sugar production
definition: Tonnes of raw sugar produced in a year. Context.
notes: added by research:context-timeline. FAOSTAT item "Raw cane or beet sugar (centrifugal only)" Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Severance paid to sugar workers
definition: Severance package for sugar workers released at closure. Context.
notes: added by research:context-timeline. One-off Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Census tracts combined per targeted employment area
definition: Mean or median number of census tracts combined to form a targeted employment area in EB-5 petitions, from a sample.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 (DHS 2016 NCE sample: mean 16, median 7).

name: Time from nomination or approval to investment
definition: Average (or other stated measure) time programme applicants take between nominating or being approved for an investment and actually transferring or investing the funds, in the unit printed. Not the authority's processing time (processing_time).
notes: proposed by research:extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11. Proposed by extract-partials-p5-2026-10-11 for MBIE AIP briefings 2024 (average time between nomination and investment of funds about four months).

name: People waiting for an investor visa number
definition: People (principals plus family) waiting for a programme's immigrant visa numbers at a date.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 (EB-5 Modernization rule 2019: 40,017 with approved petitions, ~73,000 incl. pending). Unlike petitions_approved_awaiting_visa it counts people, not petitions.

name: Visa-free destinations
definition: Destinations passport holders can visit without a prior visa.
notes: Rankings are proprietary; link rather than copy

name: Immigrant visa numbers used (visas issued plus adjustments of status)
definition: Immigrant visas issued abroad plus adjustments of status under the programme categories in a period, principals plus family.
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. US EB-5: State Department Report of the Visa Office, Table V (Part 3), '5th Total'. Counted by foreign state of chargeability (normally country of birth). The closest measure of people actually obtaining EB-5 green cards in a fiscal year (US fiscal year: 1 Oct-30 Sep). Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Programme places planned
definition: Planning level (ceiling or allocation) of visa places set for a programme in a year, primary and secondary applicants. Status budget.
notes: added by research:closed-west. A target, so status is budget. Compare with residence_permits_issued for the outcome. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Programme planning level as a share of a wider planning category
definition: Planned places for a programme (or a set-aside) as a percentage of a wider planning category, as printed. Status budget.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-aus1. proposed by extract-cbi-aus1 for the BIIP share of the 2019-20 Skill stream (6.3%) in the 2019 Home Affairs consultation paper.

name: Application withdrawal rate
definition: Applications withdrawn as a percentage of applications or finalisations in a period, as printed.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-aus1. proposed by extract-cbi-aus1 for the Australian SIV (33.7% in 2018-19; and the withdrawal rates in FOI FA 21/10/01119).
